services.name: Dino Summer Camps
services.desc: are for children and incorporate forest school, science, palaeontology and earth sciences. Camps take place at the Museum, Pipestone Creek Park, and Saskatoon Island. Camps are educational and fun, including interactions with palaeo staff and a visit to the bone bed. It's dinosaurs galore! Campers also have the exciting opportunity to go rafting on the Wapiti River (weather permitting) Each camp has maximum 15 campers with 2+ camp counsellors. Campers should bring outdoor clothing appropriate for the current weather conditions, a water bottle, packed lunch (nut free), water clothing, sunscreen and bug spray.
